title: Adding the extra gold lot when the fall accelerates, on a rebound, when deep or back above the 20-week MA — no timing could be told apart from an ordinary decline week; in 5 past episodes (5 paths, no bound) extra lots on accelerating-fall weeks gave a slightly lower average cost, and so a slightly higher return at the same exit price, with more lots
question: During a gold decline, does a week with an accelerating fall, a rebound start, a deep drawdown or a move back above the 20-week MA have a better forward return than an ordinary decline week — i.e. is it a better week for the extra lot?
hypothesis: Trader's view: when the fall accelerates, or a rebound starts, add two lots instead of one.

findings.title: No add-on timing could be told apart from an ordinary week in a decline
findings.detail: Against all weeks ≥10% below the high (2,215 weeks; 2,189 have a 26-week outcome, mean +2.73%, median +1.06%). 26-week mean (median): accelerating fall +5.36% (+1.51%; 248 weeks, 56 episodes; effect +2.64, bound 12.60); rebound start +6.65% (+3.36%; 59 weeks, 38 episodes; +3.93, bound 24.81); deep ≥20% +2.00% (+0.37%; 1,891 weeks, 7 episodes; −0.73, bound 5.90); back above the 20-week MA +3.91% (+2.18%; 129 weeks, 64 episodes; +1.18, bound 17.04). Signs lean positive for C1, C2 and C4 at 13 and 26 weeks, but all within the bound, so this sample cannot tell them apart. Means are pulled up by a few large rallies (accelerating fall: mean +5.36% vs median +1.51%). The deep-fall baseline is 86% deep-fall weeks itself, which dilutes its difference, and it has only 7 episodes, so its bound is narrow. Post-hoc (not registered, not among the reproducible numbers on this page): against the weeks 10-20% below the high instead, the deep-fall 26-week difference is negative and still inside the bound.
findings.title_zh: 這個樣本分不出任何補倉時機和下跌中的一般週有差別
findings.detail_zh: 對照：所有離高點 10% 以上的週（2,215 週，其中 26 週後有資料的 2,189 週，26 週平均 +2.73%、中位數 +1.06%）。26 週後平均（中位數）：跌勢加速 +5.36%（+1.51%；248 週、56 段；差 +2.64，門檻 12.60）；開始反彈 +6.65%（+3.36%；59 週、38 段；差 +3.93，門檻 24.81）；跌深 ≥20% +2.00%（+0.37%；1,891 週、7 段；差 −0.73，門檻 5.90）；站回 20 週線 +3.91%（+2.18%；129 週、64 段；差 +1.18，門檻 17.04）。跌勢加速、開始反彈、站回 20 週線的平均在 13、26 週都略偏正，但都在門檻內，這個樣本分不出差別。平均被少數大漲拉高（跌勢加速平均 +5.36% 對中位數 +1.51%）。跌深的基準有 86% 就是跌深週本身，差被稀釋，而且只有 7 段，門檻偏窄。事後補算（未登記，也不在本頁可重現的數字內）：改和離高點 10–20% 的週比，跌深 26 週的差是負的，仍在門檻內。

findings.title: In 5 past 25% declines, extra lots on accelerating-fall weeks gave a slightly lower average cost (so a slightly higher return at the same exit price), with more lots; in 2026 so far it did not
findings.detail: Plan: 1 lot a week for 26 weeks from the first week 25% below the high, plus one extra lot in accelerating-fall weeks (C1). Registered metrics, five past episodes: average cost lower by 0.3-2.6% (1973 −2.58%, 1975 −0.57%, 1980 −0.96%, 2008 −1.36%, 2013 −0.30%); 26-week return higher by 0.3-3.1 points; 52-week return higher in all five (the return is exit price over average cost, so with the same exit price a lower average cost and a higher return are one result, not two; 1973 +35.87% vs +32.36%, 1975 −12.56% vs −13.06%, 1980 −18.35% vs −19.14%, 2008 +24.01% vs +22.32%, 2013 −3.94% vs −4.23%). Post-hoc (not registered): counted in lot-equivalents, the 52-week loss is larger with the extra lots in 1975 (−4.05 vs −3.44), 1980 (−5.86 vs −4.72) and 2013 (−1.32 vs −1.06), because the plan holds 6-9 more lots (32, 34, 35 vs 26); the return per unit of cost was not worse. One path per episode, five episodes, no bound. 2026 (start 2026-03-16, the first week 10% or more below the high at −14.9%; the fall has not reached 25%): accelerating fall fired 9 times, average cost 4,410.87 vs 4,408.98 (+0.04%), 26-week return −0.74% vs −0.70%.
findings.title_zh: 過去 5 次大跌，跌勢加速時多買：均價略低（同一個出場價，所以報酬率也略高），但口數較多；2026 年到目前沒有這個好處

findings.title: This week meets the accelerating-fall and deep conditions
findings.detail: Week of 2026-10-19: close 3993.69, -24.33% from the high-close, 4-week -6.85%, 20-week MA 4229.95. C1 true, C3 true, C2 and C4 false.
findings.title_zh: 這週符合「跌勢加速」與「跌深」

card_summary: No add-on timing could be told apart from an ordinary decline week; in 5 past episodes (5 paths, no bound) extra lots on accelerating falls gave a slightly lower average cost, and so a slightly higher return at the same exit price, with more lots (a larger absolute loss in the 3 losing episodes, post-hoc).
title_zh: 補倉時機：跌勢加速、開始反彈、跌深、站回 20 週線，都分不出和一般下跌週的差別；過去 5 次（5 條路徑、無界線），跌勢加速時多買的版本均價略低（同一個出場價，所以報酬率也略高），但口數較多
question_zh: 黃金下跌期間，跌勢加速、開始反彈、跌深、站回 20 週線的那一週，之後的報酬是否比一般下跌週好？也就是說，多補的那一口該放哪一週？
hypothesis_zh: 交易者的想法：跌深的力道增加，或開始有反彈跡象時，可以補兩口。
card_summary_zh: 分不出哪種補倉時機比一般下跌週好；過去 5 次（5 條路徑、無界線）跌勢加速時多買，均價略低（同一個出場價，所以報酬率也略高），但口數較多，續跌時絕對虧損較大（事後補算）。
limitations_zh: 只用週收盤；名目美元；沒有持有成本、轉倉、手續費。
未來報酬視窗互相重疊，反彈與均線條件在 52 週只有很少的獨立樣本。
跌深只有 7 段，而且佔基準的 86%，門檻偏窄、差被稀釋；平均右偏，中位數較低。
C1–C4＝跌勢加速、開始反彈、跌深、站回 20 週線。「段」＝相隔超過 13 週（登記寫 13 週以上；改用 13 週以上時 C1–C4 為 59／40／8／65 段）。C1 的「前一個 4 週」是前一段不重疊的 4 週；改讀成上週的 4 週報酬，C1 週數較少、26 週差方向相同（事後補算，不在本頁可重現的數字內）。
試算只有過去 5 次事件，每次一條路徑、沒有誤差界線；2026 年這次還沒結束，起點規則（第一次離高點 10%）是寫程式時才定的，和另外 5 次（第一次跌 25%）不同。口數損益、互補組比較和 C1 另一種讀法是事後補算。
interpretation_zh: 這個樣本分不出哪一種時機比較好（四個條件在 13／26／52 週、兩個對照組下都在門檻內，這是「分不出」，不是證明沒差），所以「哪一週多補」沒有資料上的理由。跌勢加速時多買，過去 5 次（5 條路徑、沒有誤差界線）均價低 0.3–2.6%（平均約 1.2%）；出場價相同，所以 26、52 週報酬率略高是均價較低的另一種說法，不是第二個好處。但口數多 2–9 口，在續跌的 1975、1980、2013 絕對虧損較大（事後補算，非登記指標），這是口數增加造成，不能說明那一週是壞時機。2026 年這次到目前沒有這個好處（均價高 0.04%）。反彈訊號和站回 20 週線的平均略偏正，但樣本少、分布右偏。本研究沒有測試減碼線或總口數上限。
